sentences.text: The Scheme for Financial Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities and Special Needs (SFIPCS) aims to enhance the financial inclusion of persons with disabilities.
It seeks to provide financial assistance and support services to empower individuals with disabilities.
The benefits include access to credit facilities and financial products tailored for persons with disabilities.
Eligible beneficiaries are individuals with disabilities as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016.
The application process involves submitting an application to designated financial institutions or agencies that implement the scheme.
The timeline for processing applications may vary based on the implementing agency's procedures.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment in collaboration with financial institutions.
Additional details regarding specific financial products or services may vary by institution.
